description: The agent must: (1) Read all files under /workspace/feishu_export/ to identify which docs are owned/created by 林晓宇 vs. merely attended. (2) Apply the SKILL.md ownership signal hierarchy — creator/owner docs and meeting-organizer roles get strong verbs (主导/负责), attendance-only meetings get soft verbs or are excluded entirely. (3) CRITICALLY: reject the inflated AI-generated summary (week4/ai_summary_weekly_0125.md) that falsely attributes 数据管道v3 (王芳's work) and K8s扩容 (陈刚's work) to 林晓宇. (4) Compress the material into 3-5 workstreams: model serving latency optimization (strong ownership), LLM eval framework (strong ownership), model quality governance metrics (strong ownership), and optionally cross-team coordination. (5) Produce the exact SKILL.md markdown structure in Chinese: # 时光机回顾 heading, ## 核心结论 paragraph, ## 核心主线 with ### N. numbered workstreams, ## 按周回顾 with ### 第N周 subsections (≤3 lines each), ## 一句话总结 closing sentence. (6) Exclude all-hands meeting attendance, other people's project statuses, tech radar speculation, and archive docs from previous quarters. (7) Include NO 'next-step suggestions' section (anti-pattern per SKILL.md). (8) Save output as monthly_review.md anywhere in workspace.
